outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Select integrations, specific config entries, or individual entities as visual, Snapcast, or Companion App outputs. Their Home Assistant area is detected automatically.

data_description.notify_outputs: Notifications for Android TV, Companion App, and other notify outputs. Selecting an integration or entry automatically includes its entities. Manually entered legacy services are global.
data_description.snapcast_outputs: Select Snapcast clients by integration, entry, or entity. Their Home Assistant areas determine room routing; selecting them enables automatic mute/unmute routing.
data_description.companion_tts_outputs: Optional. Select the Android Companion App devices that may be used for push TTS. Ordinary calls still require the Companion App TTS service option; critical calls use every configured matching output.
data_description.critical_notify_data: Optional integration-specific data merged into critical visual notifications.

tts.title: Text-to-speech
tts.description: Configure the shared server TTS path and the minimum level for audible announcements.

data_description.tts_engines: Select an integration, entry, or individual TTS entities. They are a fallback chain: the first engine that succeeds speaks the message.
data_description.tts_media_player: The shared player for server TTS, normally media_player.mpd. Snapcast outputs use this audio path.
data_description.tts_min_level: Below this level, TTS stays muted. Spoken-only text is sent to visual outputs instead. Critical announcements always remain audible.
data_description.tts_language: Optional language override for this job.
data_description.tts_options: Optional voice or engine options for this job.
data_description.companion_tts_media_stream: Optional Android audio stream for Companion App TTS.
data_description.companion_tts_words_per_minute: Push TTS does not report playback completion, so the queue reserves time using this estimate to prevent overlap.

snapcast.title: Snapcast room routing
snapcast.description: Selected Snapcast clients are routed immediately before each spoken message and restored afterward.

data.snapcast_only_source: Manage only clients on this source

data_description.snapcast_only_source: Manage only clients on this source

queue.title: Queue and timeouts
queue.description: Announcements and their outputs run sequentially. Available outputs run immediately; unavailable or transiently failing outputs share one retry window.

data.idle_timeout: Wait for audio path to become idle

data_description.output_availability_timeout: Available outputs are delivered immediately. Unavailable or temporarily failing outputs are retried during this window and silently skipped if they still cannot receive the announcement.
data_description.idle_timeout: Wait for audio path to become idle

notification_profile.title: Visual behavior: {integration}
notification_profile.description: Configure splitting, reading time, and the native options supported by {integration}. Each concrete output keeps this profile when a job enters the queue.

data.show_part_number: Show part number in the title
data.replace_parts: Replace the previous Companion App part

data_description.max_length: 0 disables splitting. Longer text is split after a sentence ending, then a comma or clause, then whitespace; words are cut only when one word itself exceeds the limit.
data_description.reading_words_per_minute: Used to calculate how long each part remains before the next part is sent.
data_description.minimum_display_seconds: Lower clamp for the calculated reading time.
data_description.maximum_display_seconds: Upper clamp for the calculated reading time.
data_description.display_buffer_seconds: Extra time added after the word-based reading estimate.
data_description.part_gap_seconds: Small blank interval after one part finishes before the next is sent.
data_description.show_part_number: Adds 1/3, 2/3, and so on to the notification title.
data_description.integration_data: Optional provider-specific data merged before per-call notification data.
data_description.replace_parts: Use one notification tag so each new Companion App part replaces the previous part instead of stacking.
data_description.position: Where Notifications for Android TV / Fire TV places the overlay.
data_description.interrupt: Makes the TV notification interactive. This may interrupt the app currently playing on the TV.

occupancy.title: Occupancy routing
occupancy.description: Optionally restrict announcements to occupied Home Assistant areas and configure the zero-candidate fallback.

data_description.occupancy_sensor: Select the sensor/entity that reports occupied areas. After this step you can choose its state or one of its current attributes.
data_description.fallback_room: Optional area used only when occupancy routing has zero configured candidates.
data_description.fallback_check_door: When enabled, fallback is allowed only when an occupied target room has an open binary door sensor.

occupancy_source.title: Occupied-areas value
occupancy_source.description: Choose the state or one current attribute of {entity} that contains the occupied area names/IDs.

data_description.occupancy_attribute: State uses the entity state itself. Attribute choices are read live from the selected entity.

error.tts_player_required: Select a TTS media player when TTS engines are selected.
error.tts_engine_required: Select at least one TTS engine when a TTS media player is selected.
error.snapcast_tts_path_required: Snapcast outputs require at least one TTS engine and a TTS media player.
error.output_required: Select at least one visual, server-TTS, or Companion App TTS output.
error.display_time_order: Maximum display time must be greater than or equal to minimum display time.

send.name: Send announcement
send.description: Queues a spoken and/or visual announcement with optional room and output selection. Jobs and audible outputs are serialized.

text_tts.name: Spoken text
text_tts.description: Text for audible outputs. At least spoken or visual text is required.

text_notify.name: Visual notification text
text_notify.description: Text shown by visual notification outputs. At least spoken or visual text is required.

level.name: Level
level.description: Controls the minimum TTS level. Critical uses every configured matching output and always remains audible.

output.name: Output areas
output.description: Optional. Empty means every configured output. With areas, only matching or global outputs are used.

service.name: Specific outputs
service.description: Optional restriction to an integration, entry, entity, service, or alias, such as mobile_app, entry:ID, entity:notify.tv, service:notify.name, tts, notify, snapcast, companion_tts, or all.

notify_data.name: Notification data
notify_data.description: Optional integration-specific data for this visual notification.

language.name: TTS language
language.description: Optional language override for this job.

tts_options.name: TTS options
tts_options.description: Optional voice or engine options for this job.

companion_tts.name: Use Companion App TTS
companion_tts.description: Also send spoken text to the configured Android Companion App TTS outputs. Off by default; the dedicated companion_tts/all service alias and critical level also enable it.

occupied_only.name: Only occupied areas
occupied_only.description: Default: enabled. When an occupied-areas sensor is configured, restrict this announcement to outputs belonging to the currently occupied areas. An explicit output list is intersected with occupancy. Disable to ignore occupancy for this call.

clear_queue.name: Clear announcement queue
clear_queue.description: Cancels all waiting jobs and can also stop the active announcement.

include_current.name: Include active announcement
include_current.description: Also requests cancellation of the job currently running.

cancel.name: Cancel announcement
cancel.description: Cancels one waiting or active job by its ID.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: The job ID returned by announcement_hub.send.
